summary.headline: Added one-press Emergency Shark Siren trigger to mitigation panel
summary.detail: Added the `Emergency Shark Siren` action button to `SharkMitigationCard`, wired to fire a zone-wide evacuation broadcast in under 500 ms with a single press and no confirmation dialog. This gives lifeguards an immediate evacuation trigger the moment a shark sighting is confirmed, replacing the previous three-sub-menu navigation path.
